name: Nixxa Copperthumb
source_profile:
Matron Nixxa Copperthumb (LN)

Nixxa is the senior representative of the Cinderhook warrens and proprietor of one of their most prosperous foundries. A stern, practical goblin with an exceptional memory for debts, she believes commercial stability is essential to her people's prosperity.

She has cautiously welcomed Cadorian merchants and prospectors, provided they pay fairly and respect existing goblin mining claims. However, she is increasingly concerned that Marquis Aldric Voss may eventually attempt to place the warrens under Blackvein's authority.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 51 (source excerpt; may be partial)
